title: Secrets of Devotion I
subtitle: Śrī Chaitanya Gauḍīya Maṭha
description: Secrets of Devotion I — a themed treasury of teachings gathered by the Śrī Chaitanya Gauḍīya Maṭha.

articles.title: Is Love for Krishna Already There in Every Jiva?
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: Bhakti is self-evident. It is innate in the nature of every soul. It is not to be borrowed from somebody else. Every living being has got that. Now it is enveloped. It is to be awakened.

blocks.text: Question:Is it that love is already there? It has been forgotten, covered and perverted into lust for material pleasures?
Srila Gurudev: Yes. You will find in Bhagavatam, 11th canto, and also you better go through writings of Rupa Goswami. There you will find in Bhakti-rasamrita-sindhu, 64 kinds of devotional forms.
Chaitanya Mahaprabhu is speaking to Sanatana Goswami,

Now I am saying about the characteristics of sādhana bhakti. By sādhana bhakti you can get supreme wealth of Krishna Prem. Sādhana bhakti means devotional practice. By devotional practice you will get the highest objective, Krishna-prem.

There it is written by Rupa Goswami, sadhya, the object end is bhava bhakti. That bhava we can get, but by practicing through the sense organs. We have got sense organs, we have to engage them for the service of Krishna and His devotees. kṛti-sādhyā bhav - That is called sadhana bhakti. nitya-siddhasya bhāvasya prākaṭyaṁ hṛdi sādhyatā.

Bhakti is self-evident. It is innate in the nature of every soul. It is not to be borrowed from somebody else. Every living being has got that. Now it is enveloped. It is to be awakened. For example, if all are sleeping, who can awaken? But if one awakened person is there, he can awaken thousands of sleeping persons. Like that. If one realized person (awaken) is there, i.e. eternal causeless devotion is manifested in him, he can manifest that to other conditioned souls. Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, Supreme Lord, did this to all the tigers and other animals and they got their eternal nature awakened. That is not possible for human beings. We cannot do. But a devotee can do.

E.g. In Assam, one little boy Kamalkant Gosai, 12 or 14 years of age met Bhaktisiddhanta Saraswati Thakur, when he was going somewhere from the math on a bullock cart. His face was just opposite to the bullocks (Towards the rear end of the cart), and Kamalkant Gosai, by touching the bullock cart, was speaking with Saraswati Goswami. Prabhupada asked him- What is your name? What do you do? Which class you study in? etc. - ordinary questions not spiritual questions. But by that what happened? - His (Kamalkant) mind changed and he did not want to remain in the house and he wanted to give up the house and go to Gaudiya math. Only by talking his mind was changed! He (Saraswati Thakur) is a realized soul because he is grace incarnate form. He is not an ordinary person. His grace is same to all. Sun is giving light to all without discrimination. God is giving His grace to all without discrimination. This is one proof. His parents got very perturbed by it. They were very orthodox Brahmins and they said you should not go there. You will lose your chastity and everything. Like this they did not allow. But he did not listen to anybody and he came to math and took renounced order diksha from our Gurudev. By that time Bhaktisiddhanta Saraswati Thakur had disappeared. Only by seeing!! It is said that svatah siddha, self-effulgence manifested, that bhakti is there but it is not manifested and all conditioned souls are sleeping souls, who will awaken? If one awakened soul is here, he can awaken many. He can rescue a universe.

Love is already there, transcendental love, it is inborn in soul. It is not to be taken from any other person. It is to be manifested by coming in contact with a person who has manifested his own eternal nature, causeless devotion to Krishna, He can give it to others.

articles.title: How to Harmonize Personal Practices and Preaching?
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: Gaurang Mahaprabhu instructed followers to practice and also to preach devotion to Sri Sri Radha Krishna. How should I nicely combine my personal practice and also preaching for good of others? Five years ago you told me that only somebody asks me something I should tell. But sometimes I also hear from devotees that I should speak to others even if they don’t specifically ask me. What is your personal advice for me now?

blocks.text: Question: Gaurang Mahaprabhu instructed followers to practice and also to preach devotion to Sri Sri Radha Krishna. How should I nicely combine my personal practice and also preaching for good of others? Five years ago you told me that only somebody asks me something I should tell. But sometimes I also hear from devotees that I should speak to others even if they don’t specifically ask me. What is your personal advice for me now?

Srila Gurudev:You see, your target should be correct. If target is to deliver a speech and get name and fame then everything is lost as I am doing. I am losing everything, not good. Target should be the satisfaction of Krishna. I cannot do this I have to pray for the grace of Guru, vaishna, Bhagwan so that I can speak for His satisfaction. When I shall surrender to Him, then He will give the capacity to speak Harikatha. Otherwise not. You will find Bhaktivinoda Thakur has said –

In his own hymn he is saying this. You give me realised form otherwise, you are transcendental, I have this mundane body, how can I serve you? Kindly give me the realised transcendental form where I can come to the Vrindavan majhe in Vrindavan dham, transcendental realm. You give the service. I cannot get it forcibly. You are not subservient to me. You give the service. If you want you can give the service. And you give me that Prem, make me drink prem and hear whatever Krishna is speaking through me, you may speak through me and you will hear, I am not speaking. You will speak through my mouth and you will hear, what is this? Very difficult. I am not that person. So you are not getting actual benefit. But He is very gracious, if we try sincerely then they will come utter that and we can speak Harikatha for the satisfaction of Krishna, Vaishnava and Guru, not for any ulterior desire.

Target should not be different, something else. Then everything will be lost. Our Bhaktisiddhanta Saraswati thakur also, in his last message said- One and all should take absolute shelter, worship the transcendental sense organs of Radha-Krishna by submitting to the transcendental counterpart Guru, grace incarnated form Guru, aChaitanya Charitamritaepting a sadhguru and your target should be the satisfaction of transcendental sense organs of Radha-Krishna. And by that you should remain united. If there are different targets you cannot remain united. This world everybody has got different target so they cannot remain united. In the transcendental realm target is one, enjoyer is one Supreme Lord. And others are servants. They are serving in different delightful relations. Appear to make this world also same thing but if you want sincerely because he is residing in our heart, sincerely if you want He will help you. He is always ready to help you. In this kaliyuga, Chaitanya Mahaprabhu has appeared and he has given order to preach this to whole world, not only India, without nama-sankirtan, bhakti nobody can be rescued, this you have to propagate.

articles.title: What Pleases Krishna More, Serving Him Directly or Serving His Radhika?
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: Narayan is speaking to Durvasa rishi. ahaṁ bhakta-parādhīno. Although I am independent, I am absolute, but it is my nature to become dependent to devotee, subservient to devotee

blocks.text: Question: Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Saraswati Thakur mentions that Radha dasya is the highest attainment. I can understand, accepted. But then, we can learn from Bhakti-rasamrita-sindhu that there are five primary rasas- Shanta, dasya, sakhya, vatsalya and madhurya rasa. Relationship with Krishna and not with Radhika. Can Maharaj tell us what Krishna desires more, serving him directly or serving His Radhika?

Srila Gurudev:
Here you see, if you go to the scriptures, what you will find? There Krishna has said - mad-bhakta-pūjābhyadhikā sarva-bhūteṣu man-matiḥ (SB 11.19.20). Why in Bhagavatam? Worship of my devotee is more than worship of me. It is His own saying. Why, mad-bhakta-pūjābhyadhikā? Revise that verse (SB 11.19.20). Again in Bengali in Chaitanya Charitamrita - amar bhakter puja ama haite bado. Can you understand Bengali?

Worship of my devotee is more than worship of me. Krishna is saying, it is in Chaitanya Charitamrita. In vedas and Bhagavat you will find proof for this. You will get scriptural evidence. Numerous evidences are there. Worship of devotee is superior to worship of Me. Superior. Don't be puzzled. Why is that? Again.

Narayan is speaking to Durvasa rishi. ahaṁ bhakta-parādhīno. Although I am independent, I am absolute, but it is my nature to become dependent to devotee, subservient to devotee, why? When devotee worships me, I want to give him something.

Take this. A true devotee does not want anything. I don't to be indebted to anybody. I am Supreme Lord, you want this? Property, Brahmand, whatever you want. He (devotee) will say No. Yoga Siddhi? No. Mukti, emancipation? No. nothing Except your service I do not want anything. So what can I do? So I have to become subservient. It is my nature. I want to payback. They do not want anything else, except Me. For that reason devotee is more important to us.
